chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Talha ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was brought a man who had tampered with his manhood, so he struck his hand until it turned red. Then he married him from the public treasury.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Ali ibn Abi Talib)

ai.seo_question: What was the punishment for self-stroking according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* records Imam Ali’s (AS) specific application of *ta'zir* (discretionary punishment) for self-stroking, distinguishing it from the fixed *hadd* of adultery by targeting the hand rather than the whole body. The subsequent marriage funded by the state treasury (*bayt al-mal*) highlights a restorative approach aimed at curbing the habit through social stabilization, reflecting the practical jurisprudence of the early Shia Imams.
